headline: DemirBank launches online registration of individual entrepreneurs in mobile app
summary: DemirBank has launched a digital service letting clients apply for individual entrepreneur registration directly in its mobile app. The bank is a Kyrgyz lender.
why: DemirBank is a Kyrgyz commercial bank, and digital onboarding services are a competitive factor in retail and small-business banking.
original_headline: DemirBank запустил онлайн-регистрацию ИП в мобильном приложении
